authority: CEO Round 156: 'A World-Class invention must beat the strongest demonstrated alternative on the actual decision that matters — not merely beat a simplified proxy of the competitor's technology. That distinction is going to matter enormously for C2-Y, C3-X and C5-X.'
constitutional_basis: Article I — evidence precedes assertion (gate conditions require evidence)
Article IV — no fallback epistemology (no weak baselines)
Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim (no weakening gate)
Article XIV — no research proceeds through a red gate (RED = STOP)
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate (gate conditions are reality-anchored, not gate-anchored)
Article XXVII — no threshold invention (every threshold has provenance)
Article XXVIII — no silent semantic promotion (independent reproduction required)
Article XXIX — separate implementation from mechanism (baseline failure ≠ candidate failure)
Article XXXII — state strongest alternative (incumbent may have undisclosed capability)
Article XXXV — closed-loop epistemic control (gate requires closed-loop validated system)

evolution_history.V1: 5 conditions (Scientific, Patent, Independent reproduction, Strategic value, Provenance) — Round 130
evolution_history.V2: 7 conditions (added Competitive moat + Buyer fit) — Round 153
evolution_history.V4_THIS_VERSION: 8 conditions, but condition 8 (COMPETITIVE_BASELINE_SUPERIORITY) now requires the full 11-field COMPETITIVE_BASELINE_CONTRACT — not just a comparison. Plus the Four Hostile Questions must be answered FAVORABLE for all four.

world_class_gate_v4.rule: WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION only when ALL of the following 8 conditions are satisfied, AND all Four Hostile Questions are answered FAVORABLE:

conditions.name: SCIENTIFICALLY_VALIDATED
conditions.requirement: Mechanism survives adversarial virtual worlds + independent reproduction + VVUQ
conditions.evidence_required: Multi-world simulation results + VVUQ report + independent solver reproduction

conditions.name: PRIOR_ART_SURVIVES
conditions.requirement: Claim-level §102/§103 analysis complete, strongest combination survived
conditions.evidence_required: Patent novelty analysis + design-around analysis + freedom-to-operate analysis

conditions.name: INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED
conditions.requirement: External solver confirms result (Article XXVIII constitutional requirement)
conditions.evidence_required: External solver (e.g., clotFoam/OpenFOAM-9 for C5-X) reproduction within pre-registered tolerance

conditions.name: COMPETITIVE_MOAT_CONFIRMED
conditions.requirement: Design-around risk acceptable, competitor cannot easily replicate

conditions.name: BUYER_FIT_CONFIRMED
conditions.requirement: At least one identified acquirer/partner for whom this plugs into existing product
conditions.evidence_required: Moat loop Q6 (would they buy us) FAVORABLE

conditions.name: COMPETITIVE_BASELINE_SUPERIORITY_V2
conditions.requirement: Material advantage over strongest publicly demonstrated alternative, documented via the 11-field COMPETITIVE_BASELINE_CONTRACT
evidence_required: Completed COMPETITIVE_BASELINE_CONTRACT (all 11 fields) for the candidate
Baseline reproduction within pre-registered fidelity tolerance (Article XXIX)
Candidate beats baseline on primary endpoint at pre-registered WIN threshold
Every threshold in the contract has provenance chain (Article XXVII)
Adversarial self-attack of the baseline (Article XVII) — adversary cannot make the candidate look better by weakening the baseline
conditions.what_V2_adds_vs_V1: V1 (Round 155) required only 'material advantage over strongest publicly demonstrated alternative' — vague. V2 (Round 156) requires the full 11-field contract with provenance, fidelity, uncertainty, metric definition, MMD, statistical power, win/kill threshold provenance, and adversarial self-attack.

the_four_hostile_questions_overlay.rule: In addition to the 8 conditions, ALL FOUR hostile questions must be answered FAVORABLE:
questions: Q1: Does it work? (Evidence: experiment results)
Q2: Was it already obvious? (Evidence: §102/§103 patent novelty analysis)
Q3: Does it beat the best alternative? (Evidence: COMPETITIVE_BASELINE_CONTRACT + independent reproduction)
Q4: Can the buyer reproduce it without us? (Evidence: moat loop Q5 + Q6)
the_four_hostile_questions_overlay.decision_rule: ANY question answered UNFAVORABLE → candidate cannot be promoted. ANY question answered UNKNOWN → candidate remains in INVESTIGATION (Article XXXIII).

world_class_gate_v4.no_compensation_rule: All 8 conditions + all 4 hostile questions are required. No compensation between dimensions. Scientific strength cannot compensate for weak competitive moat. Commercial attractiveness cannot compensate for weak science. A favorable answer on Q1 cannot compensate for an unfavorable answer on Q4.

None of the current candidates has done any of this yet.
